card.name: Space before dose-increment amounts
card.fires_on: The space just before a number, right after phrases like "increased in", "increments of" or "increase by" in dose-titration instructions. The number that follows is a round dose step such as 500 or 50.

modes.label: After "increased in"
modes.description: The space after "in" where a step size such as 500 mg increments comes next.

modes.description: The space after "increments of" or "increase by" before the step amount.
